# serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters — concept pack (small)

> Source-anchored research for serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters. Run status: COMPLETED.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-23 · budgeted to ≈8000 tokens; the full catalogue is llms-full.txt -->

## How it works

- [statement] MongoDB documents serverStatus.bucketCatalog as a document reporting metrics related to the internal storage of time series collections. $collStats exposes storageStats only when the storageStats option is specified; the manual's time-series example uses storageStats: {}, and the option syntax also permits storageStats: { scale: <number> }. For a sharded collection, $collStats returns one document per shard. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/collStats.md — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/ · keywords: serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/collStats.md

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] MongoDB defines `numBucketsClosedDueToMemoryThreshold` as closures when active buckets exceed the allowed bucket catalog cache size; `numBucketsClosedDueToCachePressure` counts closures when a bucket exceeds a dynamic size limit derived from storage-engine cache availability and `numBuckets`, which differs from the maximum bucket size limit. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/ · keywords: serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/collStats.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The `bucketCatalog` documentation distinguishes state measures such as `numBuckets`, `numOpenBuckets`, `numIdleBuckets`, and `memoryUsage` from event counts such as `numBucketInserts`, `numBucketUpdates`, `numCommits`, `numWaits`, and `numMeasurementsCommitted`. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/ · keywords: serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/collStats.md
- [statement] `numBucketInserts` counts new buckets and `numBucketUpdates` counts updates to existing buckets; MongoDB's design README says the first committed write batch inserts a bucket and later batches update it. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus.md ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/bucket_catalog/README.md — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/ · keywords: serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/timeseries/README.md
- [statement] MongoDB describes the $collStats time-series output as time series data for internal diagnostic use, and points to bucketCatalog for the fields. The example collection-level document shares some counters with serverStatus.bucketCatalog (e.g. numBucketInserts, numBucketUpdates) but also has fields such as bucketsNs, bucketCount, avgBucketSize and numActiveBuckets that the serverStatus metric table does not list. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/collStats.md — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/operator/aggregation/collStats.md · keywords: serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/
- [statement] A July 16, 2026 report by Sangki Han shows `numBuckets` at 9,033 and `numBucketsClosedDueToMemoryThreshold` at 3,459,670 during an in-progress backfill. In a later completed 4,896,000-document run, after the author changed the memory threshold and bucket granularity, the report records that closure counter at zero. These are observations from one workload. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://sangkihan.github.io/posts/mongodb-timeseries-migration/ · keywords: serverStatus bucketCatalog and collStats timeseries counters · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/serverStatus/
- [statement] Percona's `mongodb_exporter` reference lists a `collstats` collector for `$collStats` and a collection-selection flag, but it does not document whether that collector exports nested `storageStats.timeseries` bucket fields. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-20) — https://github.com/percona/mongodb_exporter/blob/main/REFERENCE.md
- [statement] MongoDB's SERVER-57287 issue records a historical result-shape bug in the legacy `collStats` command on `mongos`: time-series statistics appeared only inside per-shard `shards` output, and MongoDB marked the issue fixed in 5.0.0-rc3 and 5.1.0-rc0. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-57287
